text_blocks.snippet: To file for divorce in Florida, you'll need to file a Petition for Dissolution of Marriage with the circuit court in the county where you or your spouse last resided. Florida requires at least one spouse to have been a resident of the state for six months prior to filing. You can file for a regular dissolution or a simplified dissolution if both parties agree and meet specific criteria, such as having no minor children and agreeing on property division.
